findings.description: Approval68 requires: "Reject invalid UTF-8 before parsing; add native regression." readCatalog decodes with readFile(path, "utf8"), which replaces invalid bytes before validateCatalog parses the text. The pinned native-probes.json records expected exit 1 but observed exit 0 for an invalid UTF-8 historical catalog. The native smoke suite has no invalid-byte fixture, so its existing passing run does not satisfy this boundary.
findings.required_change: Read catalog bytes and reject invalid UTF-8 before JSON parsing. Preserve valid inputs and input bytes. Add a native malformed-byte regression through the owning validate and select commands, with byte-level preservation assertions and valid historical/current controls. Keep persistence in the shared upgrade operations.
